title: Closure of Tourism-related and Retail Businesses and Efforts to Stimulate Growth In These Sectors
what_it_is: Closure of Tourism-related and Retail Businesses and Efforts to Stimulate Growth In These Sectors

sections.label: Retail business closures and openings
sections.summary: From January 2020 to September 2021, 8,600 retail businesses ceased operations while 15,570 new ones were set up, a net increase of 6,970.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: From January 2020 to September 2021, 8,600 retail businesses ceased operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This was 330 more than the same period between 2018 and 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: However, there were 15,570 new retail businesses set up, resulting in a net increase of 6,970 retail firms over the same period from January 2020 to September 2021.

sections.label: Licensed tourist guides numbers
sections.summary: The total number of licensed tourist guides remains around 2,900 despite 175 not renewing their licences during this period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The total number of licensed tourist guides is still around 2,900, even with 175 tourist guides choosing not to renew their licences during this period.

sections.label: Tourism retrenchment and reemployment
sections.summary: Between January 2020 and 20 October 2021, 4,373 core tourism workers were retrenched, 58% locals, with 67% of locals retrenched in 2020 reemployed within six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Between January 2020 and 20 October 2021, 4,373 workers were retrenched across the core tourism industries, 58% of whom were locals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: However, with early intervention and support under the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Initiative, 67% of the locals, who were retrenched between January and September 2020, found new employment within six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the tourist guides, while we do not track the redeployment of tourist guides, close to 250 tourist guides have served as Safe Distancing Ambassadors with STB.

sections.label: Retail employee retrenchments 2020
sections.summary: In 2020, 1,180 retail employees had been retrenched.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In 2020, 1,180 retail employees had been retrenched.
